name: Wildcard Deconstruct grants the Deconstruction spell power buff (#7444)
contract: Deconstruct 283344/954082 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x40, reusing the Devastate hack in Spell::EffectWeaponDmg at SpellEffects.cpp:4086-4104) already sunders armor and deals weapon damage natively on every cast, adding one Sunder Armor stack each time.

It never cast Deconstruction 954083 (DBC effect 0 dummy, effect 1 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT, BasePoints -1, RealPointsPerLevel 1.2, BaseLevel 1), so the caster never gained the stacking +SP buff described as lasting 1 second per stack of Sunder Armor on the target.

Three Deconstruct casts land three Sunder Armor stacks on a fresh target (no Glyph of Devastate fixture); the fix reads that native stack count after the hit and grants Deconstruction with duration = stacks * 1000 ms.

steps.label: Duration matches three Sunder Armor stacks (3000 ms, allowing for elapsed ms)
